reason: FEASIBILITY: survives (the change is only a knob), but the test has almost no statistical power and two parts of the plan are moot. (1) Implementation is free. tools/div_insert.py already has cap_video, threshold and steal_frac, and the kernel sets them with --set DIVINS_CAP / DIVINS_THRESH. candidate_triples and DaughterNet node scoring do not depend on the cap, so Kaggle runtime does not change and no new node is added (no change to the node-count term). The stage runs last (linefit -> edgefilter -> swapfix -> stitch -> divinsert), so leaf prune, short-track and gap closing cannot undo it. Steals only take edges with edge_prob < 0.3, so ILP-backed stitch and edge-filter re-links (prob >= 0.3) are protected. (2) The lab can run it. replay.py already composes ef/st/sw with insertion. The 135-video stitch run took 418 s, so 199 videos x 5 configs fit in one CPU kernel. (3) Moot or unmeasurable parts: (a) The refined 'looser threshold' is already shipped. Probe 28 uses ensemble 0.4, which calibrates to OOF 0.5 (CONTEXT 03:10). At OOF 0.5 with cap 4, 55/64 SELECTION and 106/135 CONFIRMATION videos already hit the cap (median 13.5-14 eligible triples per video, 0 missing p). Lowering the threshold further changes only ~30 videos, about 1 evaluable fork: zero power. (b) Raising the cap does add insertions: about +3-4 per saturated video, ~450-600 on 199 videos. At the measured ~3% evaluable rate that is ~13-18 marginal evaluable forks, about half in 44b6, whose overlapping crops correlate them. A binomial 90% CI of about +-0.2 cannot separate p = 0.17 from 0.33. The original criterion 'marginal p >= 0.17 on BOTH embryos' cannot be evaluated: 44b6 had 1 TP / 3 FP evaluable in total at cap 4. The only direct prior is cap 4 -> 6 at t0.6 on SELECTION: +50 insertions, 0 TP / +2 FP. (c) The track-scaled cap is ~10 lines plus kernel parity, but the data refute density scaling (Spearman 0.02). (4) Lab/kernel mismatch on the intended base: no lab run has ever combined insertion with lp030 or ef. The lab reads precomputed OOF p (node_p_oof.parquet) for 1,012,255 nodes exported from exp39-graph triples, while the kernel scores the triple nodes of its own final graph on the fly. On an ef base, re-linked (u, c1) pairs can involve c1 nodes without p. The lab skips them (divins_missing_p) but the kernel would score them, so the lab under-counts eligible triples, and even the cap-4 control on the ef base is unmeasured. (5) Validation: SELECTION and CONFIRMATION were both used for the v1 choice, so a cap picked on all 199 videos has no holdout. The public LB cannot arbitrate either, because marginal p ~0.25 sits at public break-even. Net: shippable within hours and testable in one CPU run, but the run will almost surely be inconclusive or close the item.
fix_if_any: Run ONE Kaggle CPU lab kernel on all 199 videos with OOF p. Configs: lp030+insert at cap 4 (the exp48 control; never measured), then caps 5, 6 and 8 at OOF threshold 0.5 with steals on. If probe 29 holds, also ef+lp030+insert at caps 4 and 8. Before trusting the ef rows, check the divins_missing_p and divins_triples counters. If missing p is above ~1% of triple nodes, export the ef-base coordinates (replay export kind) and re-score them with kdn-score OOF (~1 GPU h) before judging. Drop the threshold arm (already shipped) and the track-scaled cap (refuted by data). Pre-register pooled criteria, not per-embryo ones: marginal evaluable forks beyond cap 4 >= 8 with precision >= 0.25, pooled score delta >= +0.0005, and neither embryo below -0.0003. Report dTP/dFP and the division-J sign at J_s = 0.13/0.20/0.25/0.36, and the adjusted-edge delta separately (steal cap grows to floor(cap/2)). If it passes, ship only as --set DIVINS_CAP=c in the private-leaning second final; no parity kernel is needed beyond a DIVINS_DUMP spot check on the 4 visible clips. Otherwise close the item.
realistic_public_gain: 0 to -0.0005 on public (marginal fork precision ~0.25 is at the public break-even J/(1+J) = 0.265). Private roughly -0.0003..+0.0005, sign-uncertain, and the lab cannot resolve it with ~15 marginal evaluable forks. Engineering cost ~1 h plus one CPU kernel (+1 GPU h if ef-base p must be re-exported).
